answer.rationale: The 18% mandate is met by the low-cost quote, but the line is at 94% with no buffer and the primary expires in 14 days without auto-renew, so a primary switch or a defer would raise delivery risk. Incumbent renewal has kept integration and deliveries stable (c1). Last year’s low-cost move (c2) is the key competing cost path and needs verification before it can justify a switch. Prior renewal benchmarking moved the incumbent on price and terms (c4) and multi-year volume pricing cut unit cost without narrowing scope (c6); use the competing quote as leverage to pursue the cut while holding the incumbent. Second-source does not replace the expiring primary in a one-decision cycle.
